title: Pete Buttigieg: ‘There’s a Fair Way’ to Bring Race-Conscious Policy Back
summary: The former Transportation Secretary also addresses data centers and his political future on SiriusXM's "The Mike Muse Show."
body_markdown:
During his upcoming appearance on[SiriusXM Urban View](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-urban-view) ‘s “The Mike Muse Show,”[Pete Buttigieg](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/pete-buttigieg) says the federal government can pursue race-conscious policies fairly.


[The Mike Muse Show SiriusXM Urban View Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogPeteButtigiegUrbanView)


During the wide-ranging conversation with Mike Muse in front of a live audience, Buttigieg defends programs designed to address racial disparities in areas like small business, education, and veterans’ services.


“I think there’s a fair way to do that,” the former Transportation Secretary says.


- **Related:[Mike Muse Hosts an Exclusive Front Row with the Cast of ‘Paradise’](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/paradise-front-row)**


Buttigieg also weighs in on reports of a potential U.S.-Saudi nuclear agreement, questioning whether expanding nuclear capabilities in the Middle East would improve regional stability.


Plus, he discusses how governments should regulate AI data centers and addresses a potential presidential run.


Listen to Pete Buttigieg’s full conversation with Mike Muse, recorded in front of a live audience, starting Saturday, July 25 at 4pm ET on SiriusXM Urban View (Ch. 26) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogPeteButtigiegUrbanView) . Watch a clip from it above now.
